Academic Recruitment

Faculty Opportunities :
  • For individuals interested in full-time teaching careers. Roles involve teaching students, guiding projects, developing course content, and contributing to academic activities. Suitable for experienced educators, industry professionals looking to move into academia, and those passionate about shaping future generations.
Research Opportunities :
  • For individuals interested in research, innovation, product development, consultancy, or funded projects. Roles may involve conducting research, publishing scholarly work, collaborating with industry, and contributing to knowledge creation. Suitable for candidates with strong research interests and expertise in their field.
Academic Leadership Opportunities :
  • For experienced professionals who can lead academic departments, schools, centres, or institutions. Roles focus on academic planning, team leadership, quality improvement, industry engagement, and strategic growth. Suitable for senior academicians and leaders with significant educational or industry experience.
Adjunct / Visiting Faculty / Professor of Practice Opportunities :
  • For working professionals, industry experts, entrepreneurs, and retired leaders who wish to contribute part-time. Opportunities include teaching specialized courses, mentoring students, sharing industry expertise, and supporting curriculum development without taking up a full-time academic role.
